lines_of_business: Community Plan policy and Medicare Advantage Coverage Summary are separate documents (Related Policy list)
'may also be applied to Medicare Advantage plans in certain instances'
effective_or_revised: Effective November 1, 2019 (printed on every page); no later revision date
sections_in_order: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services
criteria_location: Coverage Rationale (p.1, one page) plus Documentation Requirements table (pp.1-2) listing what medical notes must contain per CPT code. Definitions (p.2) define the diagnoses.
procedures_covered: Balloon sinus ostial dilation of frontal, maxillary, sphenoid sinuses (31295, 31296, 31297, 31298)

logic.top_level: any (two conditions, CRS or RARS, each an ALL list), then 'unproven' exclusions

k_of_n.quote: CT scan with findings of one or more of the following: Mucosal thickening; Bony remodeling; Bony thickening; Obstruction of the ostiomeatal complex; Opacified sinus

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: A closing 'unproven and not medically necessary' list: 'Nasal polyps or tumors' and 'All other conditions that do not meet the above criteria'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Persistence of symptoms despite administration of full courses of all of the following treatments: Antibiotic therapy, if bacterial infection is suspected, Nasal lavage, and Intranasal corticosteroids
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'all of the following' includes a conditional item (antibiotics only if bacterial infection suspected). A chart without suspected bacterial infection must satisfy the other two; 'full courses' has no duration.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Chronic Rhinosinusitis of the sinus to be dilated is confirmed on a computed tomography (CT) scan
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: CT confirmation is per sinus to be dilated; a multi-sinus request needs per-sinus evidence.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Balloon sinus ostial dilation is performed either as a stand-alone procedure or as part of Functional Endoscopic Sinus Surgery (FESS)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Written as an 'ALL' bullet but is satisfied by either setting; it is effectively a non-restriction.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Sinonasal symptoms, and CT evidence of ostial occlusion and/or mucosal thickening
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: RARS sub-bullets: 'Sinonasal symptoms' not defined; 'and/or' in the CT item.
Excluded as unproven, yet CRS 'with nasal polyps' is not excluded in the CRS definition; polyps seen on CT count as 'opacified sinus' etc. Conflicts are unresolved.

requirement_kinds.quote: Chronic Rhinosinusitis which has lasted longer than 12 weeks
Recurrent Acute Rhinosinusitis with four or more episodes per year with distinct symptom free intervals between episodes

Persistence of symptoms despite administration of full courses of all of the following treatments: Antibiotic therapy, if bacterial infection is suspected, Nasal lavage, and Intranasal corticosteroids

confirmed on a computed tomography (CT) scan with findings of one or more of the following: Mucosal thickening, Bony remodeling, Bony thickening, Obstruction of the ostiomeatal complex, Opacified sinus
limited to the frontal, maxillary or sphenoid sinuses
CT evidence of ostial occlusion and/or mucosal thickening in the sinus to be dilated
Medical notes documenting all of the following: History of illness; Recent physical exam; One of the following ...
each episode needs to be diagnosed by a clinician
Additional testing, if applicable: Endoscopically obtained cultures; Allergy testing; Peripheral eosinophil count; Immunodeficiency evaluation

thresholds.quote: Chronic Rhinosinusitis which has lasted longer than 12 weeks
four or more episodes per year with distinct symptom free intervals
sudden onset of symptoms ... of up to 4 weeks duration

time_windows.quote: four or more episodes per year

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: CPT 31295-31298 appear both in the Documentation Requirements table (as a merged cell spanning four codes) and the Applicable Codes table. No ICD-10 list.
codes.non_covered_code_lists: none; 'Listing of a code in this policy does not imply that the service ... is a covered or non-covered health service.'

external_dependencies.quote: the member specific benefit plan document must be referenced as the terms of the member specific benefit plan may differ from the standard plan
Medicare does not have a National Coverage Determination (NCD) for balloon sinus ostial dilation. Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) do not exist at this time.
Related Commercial Policy: Functional Endoscopic Sinus Surgery (FESS)
UnitedHealthcare may also use tools developed by third parties, such as the MCG Care Guidelines

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: An inflammatory process that involves the paranasal sinuses and persists for longer than 12 weeks
four episodes per year of acute rhinosinusitis with distinct symptom free intervals between episodes
sudden onset of symptoms of purulent nasal drainage accompanied by nasal obstruction, facial pain/pressure/fullness, or both of up to 4 weeks duration

vague_terms.quote: full courses of all of the following treatments
vague_terms.problem: 'full course' has no duration for lavage or steroid; Cigna and Centene give weeks

vague_terms.quote: Antibiotic therapy, if bacterial infection is suspected
vague_terms.problem: suspicion is a judgment; a chart showing no antibiotic cannot tell 'not suspected' from 'not tried'

vague_terms.quote: distinct symptom free intervals between episodes
vague_terms.problem: how long counts as 'distinct'? not defined

vague_terms.quote: Systemic and/or topical steroids; Topical and/or systemic decongestants; Treatment of concomitant allergic rhinitis
vague_terms.problem: documentation list asks for items that are not in the coverage criteria (decongestants, allergic rhinitis treatment, systemic steroids)

extraction_hazards: Documentation Requirements table: CPT codes 31295, 31296, 31297, 31298 are in a left cell that spans the whole right-hand block; text extraction splits the codes across pages (31295 on page 1, 31296-31298 at the top of page 2) and the list continues after the page break.
Bullets are private-use glyphs; sub-bullets (o) and sub-sub-bullets (square) differ by indentation only.

Documentation Requirements and Coverage Rationale list the same concepts in different words (CT findings list lacks 'in the sinus to be dilated' in the table; the table adds decongestants and allergic rhinitis).
Footer repeats on each page ('Proprietary Information of UnitedHealthcare').
Roughly 8 pages of clinical evidence follow a 1-page criteria section; keyword hits on 'failed medical therapy' there are not criteria.
Effective date 2019 appears alongside references and codes that are older; no revision after 11/2019 despite file retrieval 2026.
interesting_structures: Criteria page plus a separate documentation-requirements table: what must be in the medical notes, keyed by CPT.
The policy permits both stand-alone and with-FESS dilation (the opposite of Florida Blue's bundling rule).
Exclusion 'All other conditions that do not meet the above criteria' makes the list closed.
Per-sinus confirmation on CT ('sinus to be dilated').
Policy history documents the shift from 'one or more' of the medical therapies to 'all' of them in 11/2019.

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = clean, 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Short, clean any(all(...)) shape with a closed list. Strain: conditional 'if bacterial infection is suspected', undefined 'full courses', per-sinus CT scoping, and a separate documentation table that restates criteria in different words.
